set.body: CanvasScrollCoordinator.enqueue coalesces wheel bursts onto a CanvasTaskScheduler but exposes no cancel/close; a host that unmounts mid-burst cannot stop the pending flush, which then runs against a closed controller. Add cancel(): Unit (and make flush a no-op after controller.close()). Acceptance: JS test — enqueue, cancel, advance scheduler, onFlush never called.
set.title: CanvasScrollCoordinator needs cancel() for host unmount
